jobs.title: Business Analyst (Remote)
jobs.location: Remote — must reside in NC, SC, GA, TN, VA, MD, or FL
jobs.description:
The primary purpose of this role is to analyze the current state of the organization's operations and processes, identify needs and opportunities, develop strategies, and maximize those opportunities. The Business Analyst will work collaboratively across all departments and communicate solutions and strategies clearly to stakeholders, facilitators, and partners. Responsibilities include root-cause and gap analysis to recommend and drive change, and acting as an efficient advisor/partner between technology, support, and business units.

Requirements: High School diploma or GED required; Bachelor's degree in Human Services, Business Administration, Public Administration, or Computer Information Systems preferred; 2 years of Business Analyst experience required.

Application deadline: open until filled. Confirmed currently accepting applications at time of this search via Vaya Health's Career Center.

Caveat: this role requires residency in NC, SC, GA, TN, VA, MD, or FL. Confirm eligibility before applying.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Develop software and machine learning algorithms to solve real-world customer problems: work with data, develop algorithms, evaluate results, and write the production code that goes onto real-world systems. Opportunities to publish novel work in both classified and unclassified settings.

Qualifications: Python and associated numerical/analytics packages (NumPy, Pandas, etc.); Git; PyTorch or TensorFlow. Machine learning fundamentals; deep knowledge of computer vision (preferred), NLP, classical ML, or Bayesian models. Bachelor's degree required (Master's or PhD preferred) in engineering, math, computer science, or related field. Excellent technical communication skills. Bonus: DoD project experience, active US security clearance.

Caveat: this posting requires US citizenship for security-clearance eligibility and willingness to relocate to/work on-site in Durham, NC (hybrid, 3+ days/week). Confirm citizenship and relocation fit before applying.
